decisive_spans.text: Heterozygous pathogenic variant of TBK1 gene (p.E643del) identified by whole-exon sequencing

response.rationale: The presence of a heterozygous pathogenic variant of the TBK1 gene (p.E643del) is a direct support item for Frontotemporal dementia and parkinsonism linked to chromosome 3 (D8) and a strong contradict item for all other candidates.
